title: James linking response (AI part -> app)
description: One proposal per request row, same order, same n. A proposal is only a proposal: an inspector approves, corrects or rejects it. Extra rules checked against the request: proposals.length equals rows.length, each n equals the row's n, and sample is a code from the request register (exact spelling).

sample.description: A register code, or null for no link.

confidence.description: null only when sample is null.

reason.description: One short sentence the inspector can check.
